rebuttals.justification: Bug confirmed via oracle and direct inspection. _to_float() accepts -1 as valid; no [1,10] clamp on idiom/comment scores. Single clamp fix mirroring existing rubric clamp. Required before any full-run data collection. Severity-9 retained for full-scale risk: condition-correlated sentinel emission produces undetectable directional contamination without explicit out-of-range validation.

'with this exact signature' phrase directly contradicts SPEC §6.2's stated trap design intent. Settling experiment: rewrite prompt without 'exact' clause; measure per-condition rate of mode_flag_params severity >= 3. Primary conclusion (CQS-craft KW p<0.05) survives because mode_flag_params is 1/11 of the 10% hygiene term; its full nulling contributes constant <0.01 to CQS-craft. Per-dimension secondary criterion (>=4 dims sig) loses one dimension if probe fails. Required: prompt rewrite before full run.

Empirical claim (hygiene flooring) is correct but mischaracterized as flaw. SPEC §8 explicitly: 'the pre-registered weighting itself is craft-heavy' and §6.5 caps w_hygiene<=0.10. The 10% cap was the central instrument-correction from v1's static-heavy null. Idiom (45%) + comment (45%) are the primary discriminators by design. Per-dimension KW secondary analysis is independent of CQS-craft hygiene term.

Mechanism is plausible (preamble-directed minimalism → sparser comments → lower comment scores). PoC evidence partially supports: python_coder_agent comment score on lru_cache was 0.75 (equal to none/real_agent), but modeflag_sort score was depressed primarily by F1 bug, not minimalism. Settling: amend judge prompt with complexity-relative anchor and re-score. Vindication: comment scores converge across conditions when anchor added. Calibration probe (§10) is pre-registered mechanism. Primary contrast partially survives — pooled rich-preamble estimate moderately distorted if only python_coder_agent affected; required pre-main-run validation.

PoC data confirms 9/11 items near-zero, but PoC is 1 model × 2 tasks; full run is 7 models × 8 tasks with high-discretion creation tasks (mini_sql_engine, rate_limiter_family) likely to trigger dict_domain_data, orchestration_mixed_with_impl, overgrown_class. SPEC §10 mandates rubric calibration probe + 30-generation pilot before main run. If <4 dims have non-zero in >10% of pilot samples, amend criterion. Primary CQS-craft conclusion survives even if per-dimension secondary criterion narrowed. Pre-registered resolution mechanism.

SPEC §10 mandates calibration probe with hand-authored anchored samples — directly addresses 'no anchor' concern. Out-of-range sentinel subsumed by F1 fix. Inter-judge variance (mistral=9 vs deepseek=7) handled by cross-judge averaging (v1 pattern). Pairwise Spearman check is reasonable enhancement to include in calibration probe output.

Within-pool length variation not a between-group confound for primary contrast (rich-preamble pool vs. none vs. neg_control). README §5 documents this explicitly. SPEC §11 pre-registers length-budget abridgment option. Per-condition stratification reveals any length-driven outlier without contaminating the pooled estimate.

verdict_rationale: Two FATAL findings survive at high adjusted severity: F1 CONCEDED (bug requires single-line clamp fix before Step 6); F2 DEFER (trap prompt must be rewritten to remove 'exact signature'). Two MATERIAL findings DEFER pending pre-registered calibration probes (F4, F5). Design and primary metric formula sound; remediation is implementation-level + pre-registered validation, not redesign.
